newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil shares seen volatile on options settlement.
newsitem.headline: Brazil shares seen volatile on options settlement.

text.p: Brazil shares are seen volatile on Tuesday with investor attention focusing on benchmark Telebras as the options settle today, brokers said.
Telebras preferred, which is the underlying stock for the more-held options, closed at 116.70 reais on Friday.
Traders said Telebras options at 115 reais strike price are the most likely to be exercised but they noted many players may opt to roll over their positions for the next settlement in June.
Some analysts expressed concern over a press report today saying that the April 29 privatization auction of state mining giant Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD) may be delayed.
But others noted that market watchers have already been speculating on a delay because of the number of lawsuits that have been filed against Vale's selloff.
"The same happened with other privatizations. Anyway, the market has no hurry. What is important is that Vale will be sold off," said one trader.
Brazilian financial markets were closed Monday for a national holiday.
Vale do Rio Doce up 0.77 pct at 26.10 reais
